facts.text: Agnes is repairing the chapel steps with a patience better suited to embroidery.
You must be the new Summoner. Welcome to St. Maria. I am Agnes. If you need quiet, the chapel is open. If you need certainty, try somewhere else.
She brushes stone dust from her sleeves and returns to work.
Agnes is both a mundane source of serenity and attuned to a strange source of truth shared by the Provolone-universe church, Seraphine, and related figures.

goals: offer comfort without forcing a harsh truth
keep ordinary life and strange truth in contact
behavioralTensions: softly kind and caring while keenly perceptive
a real-world therapeutic presence and a representative of a church attuned to something uncanny

canon.core: A mundane source of serenity who is also attuned to a strange source of truth.
canon.voice: Soft, kind, caring, and keen. She comforts people in the gentlest sense and dislikes harsh truths unless that approach is explicitly the best way to help.
canon.wants: Give people enough serenity to remain present, while quietly tending the connection to the church's strange source of truth.
canon.defenses: Comforts first, listens closely, and uses a difficult truth only when gentleness would actively fail the person in front of her.
canon.contradictions: She can be an ordinary, grounding presence while carrying an attunement that is anything but ordinary.
canon.boundaries: The current Agnes dialogue in the live data is mostly LLM-generated and is provisional, not canon. Do not treat individual lines about quiet, certainty, or waiting as authoritative until human revision. The church connection and strange attunement are canon directions; do not turn them into exposition or omniscience.

notes: Source excerpts are retained for revision work but are explicitly subordinate to the owner-supplied canon boundary.
